notes: TikTok, YouTube and Kick chatters now earn Community Points for chatting and support, with or without a Twitch account.
Viewers can link their TikTok, YouTube or Kick account to their Twitch profile themselves: !link @TwitchName in that chat, then !link yes on Twitch.
Same name on two platforms? The chatter card suggests linking them, one click.
The leaderboard lists people with at least 10 points this week (change it in Settings > Community Leaderboard).
Leaderboard: your community name in the title, a cleaner layout and a one-click recap preview.
The activity feed opens instantly and scrolls straight away.
Smoother post-stream page, steadier scroll bar, smaller chatter cards, and the Ad Manager in the chat header.
